rapport_notes: Extremely patient through a long, disorganized call (customer booking for someone else, many tangents about boxes/packing/phone number changes) without ever sounding rushed.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "Do you have any concerns or any important things that you wanted to answer on this call?" -- asked immediately after the quid pro quo, before any other question.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "if you still have extra time just to prepare... the less time you take the less money end up spending" -- self-prep tip delivered.

top_strength: Communication differentiator (day-before courtesy text/call, day-of ETA) was volunteered clearly when the customer asked how communication works -- a genuine, specific answer rather than a deflection to the confirmation email.
coaching_note: Booking happened reactively (customer asked 'are we booked for that day?') rather than the rep making an explicit close ask -- practice initiating the ask rather than waiting for the customer to prompt it.
